description: This file defines the CoapContext class, which manages context information during the processing of CoAP requests in the Eclipse Hono project. It extends a map-based execution context and includes methods for creating instances from CoapExchange objects, handling timing, and sending responses.

classes.name: CoapContext
classes.description: Represents the context for a CoAP request, including exchange details and timing metrics.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Creates a CoapContext instance from a CoapExchange, optionally with a timer for measurement.

methods.name: getExchange
methods.description: Returns the CoapExchange associated with this context.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Returns the timer object used for measuring request processing duration.

methods.name: respondWithCode
methods.description: Sends a response back to the device with the specified CoAP response code.
